paper_title: New CAST Limit on the Axion-Photon Interaction
notes: CAST helioscope final vacuum phase (2013-2015). Main result: g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 (95% C.L.) for m_a < 0.02 eV. This is a solar axion search (Primakoff production), not a DM haloscope, so no DM density assumed. The limit is mass-independent below 0.02 eV; data points represent the flat exclusion across this mass range. Above ~0.02 eV coherence is lost and sensitivity degrades. | Auto-corrected masses: meV→eV (×1.000e-03, rule=argmin|log10(median*f)-log10(anchor=1.0e-05)|)
